_comment: Bone map: Quaternius 'LowPoly Animated Knight' rig -> the shared humanoid
Two things about this rig are worth knowing, because both are typical:
1. The names do not line up with the profile the way they first appear. The
source 'Body' bone is the parent of both the spine and the legs, so it is
the profile's Hips; the source 'Hips' is one level further up and becomes
Spine, 'Abdomen' becomes Chest and 'Torso' becomes UpperChest. Mapping by
position in the hierarchy rather than by name is what makes retargeting
2. The thumb bones are labelled on the wrong sides in the source: 'Thumb.R'
hangs off LowerArm.L. They are mapped to the side they are actually on.
PoleTarget.L / PoleTarget.R are IK helpers, and Foot.L / Foot.R are parented
to the rig root rather than to the shin because the legs are IK-driven. The
feet are mapped by name but deliberately not reparented: the animation keys
are local to the parent they were authored against, so reparenting would
break every animation in the pack.
